sentences.en: For the past two weeks, President Trump has been trying and failing to get his base to stop talking about Jeffrey Epstein.
sentences.zh: 在过去的两个星期里，特朗普总统一直在试图让他的核心支持者停止谈论杰弗里·爱泼斯坦，但没有成功。

sentences.en: Today, my colleagues David Enrich and Sean McCreish explain why MAGA won't let go of this scandal, how the president misread his own base,
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事大卫·恩里奇和肖恩·麦克里什将解释为什么MAGA不肯放过这桩丑闻，总统是如何误判了他自己的支持者，

sentences.en: and what all this shows about the limits of Trump's power.
sentences.zh: 以及这一切说明了特朗普权力的局限性。

sentences.en: It's Monday, July 21St.
sentences.zh: 今天是7月21日，星期一。

sentences.en: David, we're in the middle of a crisis that the White House has so far been unable to control, which is this growing anger over the administration's refusal
sentences.zh: 大卫，我们正处于一场白宫至今无法控制的危机之中，这就是公众对政府拒绝配合的日益增长的愤怒

sentences.en: to release the complete files in the Jeffrey Epstein investigation.
sentences.zh: 公布杰弗里·爱泼斯坦调查案的完整档案。

sentences.en: You're an investigative editor at The Times, and you've been involved in some of the biggest investigations that The Times has done surrounding Epstein.
sentences.zh: 你是《时报》的调查编辑，你参与了《时报》围绕爱泼斯坦开展的一些最大规模的调查。

sentences.en: So we've come to you to understand, why won't this go away?
sentences.zh: 所以我们来找你，是为了解：为什么这件事就是挥之不去？

sentences.en: This won't go away because it involves a collection of some of the world's richest and most powerful people and institutions and a whole slew of unanswered questions.
sentences.zh: 这件事挥之不去，是因为它涉及一群世界上最富有、最有权势的人和机构，以及一大堆未解之谜。

sentences.en: So to just step back for a sec, let's just start with the story that most of us know about Jeffrey Epstein.
sentences.zh: 所以我们退一步讲，先从我们大多数人所知的关于杰弗里·爱泼斯坦的故事开始。

sentences.en: He was a self-styled financier living in New York and in Florida and on a private island.
sentences.zh: 他是一个自封的金融家，生活在纽约、佛罗里达和一个私人岛屿上。

sentences.en: He was associated with some really rich and famous people, most notably for our purposes, probably Donald Trump,
sentences.zh: 他与一些真正富有和出名的人交往，对我们而言最值得注意的可能就是唐纳德·特朗普，

sentences.en: with whom he spent a lot of time in the 90s and early 2000s hanging out, flying on planes together, and Trump at times remarked on their shared interest in women.
sentences.zh: 他在90年代和2000年代初曾与爱泼斯坦花了很多时间在一起闲逛、一起坐飞机，特朗普有时还会谈到他们对女性的共同兴趣。

sentences.en: And the other really important thing about Epstein is that in 2008, he pleaded guilty to sex crimes down in Florida, spent a brief period in jail.
sentences.zh: 关于爱泼斯坦，另一个非常重要的事实是，在2008年，他在佛罗里达州对性犯罪认罪，在监狱里度过了很短的一段时间。

sentences.en: And then in 2019, he was arrested on federal sex trafficking charges.
sentences.zh: 然后，在2019年，他因联邦性交易指控被捕。

sentences.en: And about a month after his arrest, he was found hanging in his jail cell in Manhattan.
sentences.zh: 在他被捕大约一个月后，他被发现死在曼哈顿的监狱牢房里。

sentences.en: And since then, there has just been a never-ending flood of conspiracy theories about what else remains out there about Jeffrey Epstein.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，关于杰弗里·爱泼斯坦还有什么内幕的阴谋论就如洪水般涌来，从未停息。

sentences.en: And it is really easy to dismiss conspiracy theories as baseless and not warranting further inquiry.
sentences.zh: 把阴谋论斥为毫无根据、不值得进一步调查，这确实很容易。

sentences.en: And I think a lot of times that's true.
sentences.zh: 我想很多时候确实如此。

sentences.en: And in this case, I don't think it's true.
sentences.zh: 但在本案中，我认为并非如此。

sentences.en: I think there are a tremendous number of unanswered questions that involve the finances and reputations of really powerful, wealthy people.
sentences.zh: 我认为有大量的未解之谜，涉及真正有权势、有钱人的财务状况和声誉。

sentences.en: And that is really the root of this.
sentences.zh: 这才是问题的核心所在。

sentences.en: There are so many things that we do not know.
sentences.zh: 有太多事情是我们不知道的。

sentences.en: — Okay.
sentences.zh: ——好吧。

sentences.en: That's why we're here.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们今天到这里的原因。

sentences.en: We want to get into those unanswered questions.
sentences.zh: 我们想深入探讨这些未解之谜。

sentences.en: Be our guide.
sentences.zh: 请带带我们。

sentences.en: Where should we start?
sentences.zh: 我们该从哪里开始？

sentences.en: — Well, I think the place to start is in Florida in the mid-2000s, when Jeffrey Epstein first attracts the notice of state and federal authorities
sentences.zh: ——嗯，我认为开始的地方应该是2000年代中期的佛罗里达州，当时杰弗里·爱泼斯坦首次引起了州和联邦当局的注意，

sentences.en: who begin investigating allegations that he sexually abused young women and girls.
sentences.zh: 他们开始调查他性虐待年轻女性和女孩的指控。

sentences.en: And this investigation went on for a while.
sentences.zh: 这项调查持续了一段时间。

sentences.en: And instead of charging him on that, they charged him on these two kind of watered-down prostitution charges
sentences.zh: 但他们没有以这些罪名起诉他，而是以两项有所淡化的卖淫罪对其实施了指控，

sentences.en: and agreed to a plea deal that would result in Epstein serving very little time in a minimum security jail with a very lenient work release program.
sentences.zh: 并达成了一项辩诉协议，结果导致爱泼斯坦在一个宽管的带有非常宽松的释放工作项目的最低安全级别监狱里服刑了很短的时间。

sentences.en: — And did this raise questions at the time?
sentences.zh: ——当时这没有引发疑问吗？

sentences.en: Because the obvious one is, why were prosecutors using such a light touch with this guy?
sentences.zh: 因为最显而易见的问题是：为什么检察官对这家伙这么心慈手软？

sentences.en: — It did not really raise very many questions at the time.
sentences.zh: ——当时确实没有引发太多疑问。

sentences.en: Certainly the people in Epstein's orbit, who he was friends with and who were providing him with money and resources and prestige, looked the other way.
sentences.zh: 当然，爱泼斯坦圈子里的人——那些与他交朋友、为他提供金钱、资源和声望的人——都选择视而不见。

sentences.en: And it really did not come back into the public view until journalists at the Miami Herald started digging into this and trying to figure out what exactly had happened.
sentences.zh: 直到《迈阿密先驱报》的记者开始深入挖掘此事、试图弄清楚究竟发生了什么，这件事才重新进入公众视野。

sentences.en: And they produced a series of stories in 2018.
sentences.zh: 他们在2018年发表了一系列报道。

sentences.en: And what they learned was that local authorities, police and prosecutors in Palm Beach County, had amassed a really large pile of very serious allegations
sentences.zh: 他们了解到的是，棕榈滩县的地方当局、警察和检察官，曾积累了大量关于爱泼斯坦一再犯下的性犯罪的极其严重的指控，

sentences.en: about sex crimes that Epstein had repeatedly committed.
sentences.zh: 并了解到那些指控作为爱泼斯坦后来达成的联邦辩诉协议的一部分，基本上被掩盖了起来。

sentences.en: And that those, as part of this federal plea deal that Epstein later struck, had essentially been swept under the rug.
sentences.zh: ——直接结果就是，爱泼斯坦不仅得到了非常轻的刑期，而且其结果是大量的证据永远不见天日。

sentences.en: — With the direct result being that not only did Epstein get a really light jail sentence, but also that the result of that was that tons of evidence never saw the light of day.
sentences.zh: 因此，公众对爱泼斯坦被指控的不当行为的严重程度仍然一无所知。

sentences.en: And the public remained really in the dark, therefore, about the extent of Epstein's alleged wrongdoing.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为故事就从这里开始，因为至今仍是个谜：为什么联邦政府会以最终基本上保护了爱泼斯坦的方式進行干预，

sentences.en: So I think that the story begins there because it remains a mystery today why exactly the federal government intervened in a way that ended up basically protecting Epstein
sentences.zh: 并将当局一直在调查的许多指控对受害者和广大公众严格保密。

sentences.en: and keeping a lot of the allegations that authorities had been investigating, keeping them secret from victims and from the public at large.
sentences.zh: ——好吧。

sentences.en: — Okay.
sentences.zh: 所以这是未解之谜之一。

sentences.en: So that's one of these unanswered questions.
sentences.zh: 爱泼斯坦是怎么得到这份优待辩诉协议的？

sentences.en: How is Epstein able to get this sweetheart plea deal?
sentences.zh: 这个案件还有哪些漏洞？

sentences.en: What are the other holes in this case?
sentences.zh: ——我的意思是，对我来说，围绕杰弗里·爱泼斯坦最大的未解之谜是他是如何获得这么多钱的。

sentences.en: — I mean, to me, the biggest outstanding mystery surrounding Jeffrey Epstein is how he got so much money.
sentences.zh: 你在媒体上每次读到爱泼斯坦时，除了他的罪行之外，都是在描写这是一个过着绝对奢华生活的人。

sentences.en: Every time you read about Epstein and the media, in a context other than his crimes, was this is a guy who was living a life of absolute luxury.
sentences.zh: 他到处都有房产。

sentences.en: He had properties all over the place.
sentences.zh: 他拥有一座岛屿。

sentences.en: He owned an island.
sentences.zh: 他有一架私人飞机。

sentences.en: He had a private jet.
sentences.zh: 他当然非常富有，他也确实赢得了某些非常富有和有权势的男人的信任。

sentences.en: He was certainly very wealthy, and he certainly had gained the confidence of some very rich and powerful men.
sentences.zh: 但他喜欢把自己标榜为对冲基金经理或金融家。

sentences.en: But he liked to style himself as a hedge fund manager or a financier.
sentences.zh: 但事实并非如此。

sentences.en: And that's just not true.
sentences.zh: 从任何角度来看，这家伙都不是真正的金融天才或奇才，也没有爬到华尔街的顶峰。

sentences.en: This was not a guy who, by any accounts, was a real financial genius or whiz or had risen to the top of Wall Street.
sentences.zh: 这只是一个有着非常肤浅、短浅资历的人。

sentences.en: This was someone who had a very kind of shallow, short track record.
sentences.zh: 那么，杰弗里·爱泼斯坦是如何积聚起这笔巨额财富的呢？

sentences.en: So, how did Jeffrey Epstein amass this enormous fortune?
sentences.zh: 对此有许多不同、相互矛盾、重叠且令人不满意的答案。

sentences.en: And there are a bunch of different, conflicting, overlapping, unsatisfying answers.
sentences.zh: 所以，尽管我们中的一些人可能记得或认为爱泼斯坦是一位富有的——正如你所说——金融家，但实际上，这家伙在现实中并不是华尔街那种类型的专家，

sentences.en: So, even though some of us may remember or think of Epstein as this wealthy, as you said, financier, like, this guy is not actually in reality to the Wall Street type,
sentences.zh: 不会被视为那种你可以把所有钱都托付给他的专家。

sentences.en: seen as, you know, an expert that you would entrust all your money to.
sentences.zh: 不，绝对不是。

sentences.en: No, absolutely not.
sentences.zh: 我在《纽约时报》的同事马特·戈尔德斯坦在这个课题上做了大量的挖掘工作。

sentences.en: And my New York Times colleague, Matt Goldstein, has just done an enormous amount of digging on this topic.

sentences.en: Probably the place to start is with a guy named Leon Black, who ran the giant private equity firm Apollo.
sentences.zh: 布拉克作为世界上最富有、最有权势的人之一，当然在华尔街也是如此，

sentences.en: And Black, one of the richest, most powerful people in the world, certainly on Wall Street,

sentences.en: has the ability to access anyone in the world that he wants to help get advice on how to deal with taxes, how to plan for his estate, things like that.

sentences.en: Who does he turn to?
sentences.zh: 杰弗里·爱泼斯坦。

sentences.en: Jeffrey Epstein.
sentences.zh: 多年来，布拉克向爱泼斯坦支付了大约1.7亿美元，作为税务和遗产规划服务的报酬。

sentences.en: Black paid Epstein something like $170 million over the years for tax and estate planning services.
sentences.zh: 需要指出的是，布拉克否认参与了爱泼斯坦的罪行。

sentences.en: And it's important to note that Black has denied any involvement in Epstein's crimes.
sentences.zh: 但两人之间财务关系的深度让许多人感到怀疑。

sentences.en: But the extent of the financial relationship between these two has left a lot of people feeling suspicious.
sentences.zh: 而且布拉克绝不是唯一的一个。

sentences.en: And Black is by no means alone here.
sentences.zh: 在爱泼斯坦的职业和个人交往圈子里有很多人，而我们并不知道那里究竟发生了什么的全部情况。

sentences.en: There were a lot of people in Epstein's orbit, professionally, personally, and we do not know the full extent of what was going on there.
sentences.zh: 人们进行了大量的猜测和报道，围绕着这样的问题：比如，他是不是抓住了他们的把柄？

sentences.en: There's been a tremendous amount of speculation and reporting into questions as to, like, did he have something on them?
sentences.zh: 这里面还有什么别的事吗？

sentences.en: Was there something else going on here?
sentences.zh: 最底线是，我们不知道。

sentences.en: And we don't know is the bottom line.
sentences.zh: 在这里做一个快速的直觉检验。

sentences.en: And just a quick gut check here.
sentences.zh: 这有多正常？

sentences.zh: 我们通常确切知道超级富豪是如何向他们的财务顾问支付报酬的，或者他们用顾问来做什么吗？

sentences.en: Do we generally know exactly how the mega-rich are paying their financial consultants or what they're using them for?
sentences.zh: 不知道。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，我们不知道。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, we don't.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这仍然是一种不寻常的情况，部分原因在于极少数富有和有权势的人会被公开指控

sentences.en: But this is still, I think this is a kind of abnormal situation, in part because very few rich and powerful people are publicly accused of
sentences.zh: 并因性犯罪而被定罪，然后还在监狱牢房里自缢身亡。

sentences.zh: 因此，杰弗里·爱泼斯坦以及他的人际关系和金钱正受到比普通富裕华尔街人士的生活更多的审视。

sentences.en: And so Jeffrey Epstein and his relationships and his money are getting a lot more scrutiny than a normal, wealthy Wall Street person's life would be.
sentences.zh: 我想，如果你有大批记者花上数年时间去挖掘华尔街大多数人的私事，

sentences.zh: 我的直觉是，要查明真相会容易得多，不像在爱泼斯坦的案子中证明得那么困难。

sentences.en: my hunch is that it would be a lot easier to ascertain the truth than it is proven in the case of Epstein.
sentences.zh: 好吧，你提到了他的悬梁自尽。

sentences.en: Okay, so you've mentioned his hanging.
sentences.zh: 其实我想谈谈爱泼斯坦的死。

sentences.en: I want to talk about Epstein's death, actually.
sentences.zh: 这是我们在各种疑问中听到最多的一件事，人们真的不相信这是一起自杀。

sentences.en: Like, this is the thing that we've heard the most about in terms of questions, in terms of people really not believing that this was a suicide.
sentences.zh: 这背后是怎么回事？

sentences.en: What's the story here?
sentences.zh: 嗯，回顾一下发生的事情，爱泼斯坦于2019年7月被捕，并被送往曼哈顿的大都会惩教中心。

sentences.en: Well, to recap what happened, Epstein was arrested in July 2019, and he was sent to the Metropolitan Correctional Facility in Manhattan.
sentences.zh: 在他被捕并关押到那里大约一两周后，他撕破了一些床单，用它做成绳套，把自己吊了起来。

sentences.en: And he, about a week or two after he had been arrested and housed there, he tore up some bed sheets, used it as a noose, and hung himself.
sentences.zh: 他被发现时已经失去意识，但还活着。

sentences.en: And he was found unconscious, but alive.
sentences.zh: 从那一刻起，他被列入防自杀监视名单。

sentences.en: And from that point forward, he was put on suicide watch.
sentences.zh: 他的牢房里本应该随时有另一名同案犯陪同。

sentences.zh: 本应该基本上随时有警卫查房看望他。

sentences.en: And he was found the following morning hanging from a bed sheet, and this time he was dead.

sentences.en: And this obviously set off even more conspiracy theories and led to even more questions about how on earth this possibly could have happened.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 大家的想法是，这家伙掌握了那么多权贵阶层的秘密，结果却死在了一个本该对他严加看管的监狱牢房里。

sentences.en: The idea is this guy is the keeper of so many powerful people's secrets, and he ends up dead in a jail cell where they were supposed to be watching him.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 更过分的是，最重要的是，除此之外，没有任何视频画面能够真正让我们深入了解

sentences.en: And what's more is that, you know, on top of all of that, there is no video footage that actually gives us insight
sentences.zh: 那个牢房里究竟发生了什么，甚至连紧邻该区域的周边区域也没有。

sentences.en: into what was going on in that cell or even in the immediate area surrounding it.
sentences.zh: 为了清楚起见，我知道证据中存在漏洞，但我们所知道的确凿事实证实了爱泼斯坦是自杀身亡的。

sentences.en: Just to be clear, I understand there are gaps in the evidence, but what we do know does confirm that Epstein died by suicide.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是研究过证据、知道自己在谈论什么的人们的明确共识。

sentences.en: Yes, that is the clear consensus among people who have studied the evidence and know what they're talking about.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，我们之所以知道许多这些细节，是因为《纽约时报》花费了多年时间，最终诉诸法庭

sentences.en: And by the way, the reason that we know a lot of those details is because the New York Times spent years and ultimately went to court
sentences.zh: 才从惩教署获得了这些记录。

sentences.en: to get these records from the Department of Corrections.
sentences.zh: 我们赢得了诉讼，记录被公之于众，因此我们了解了曼哈顿监狱当晚他死亡情况的大量细节。

sentences.en: We won the lawsuit, the records were revealed, and we therefore learned a lot about the circumstances of his death that night in the Manhattan jail.
sentences.zh: 但仍然有大量的未解之谜。

sentences.en: But there was still a ton of unanswered questions.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们也知道监狱可能是非常混乱的地方、充满暴力的地方、常常管理不善的地方。

sentences.en: Obviously, we know, though, that jails can be very chaotic places, violent places, places that are often mismanaged.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我有点想知道，你能在多大程度上把这一切仅仅归咎于此？

sentences.en: And, I mean, I sort of wonder how much of this you could just chalk up to that.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，仅仅是监狱里标准的、典型的管理不善的失误。

sentences.en: I mean, just standard, typical mismanagement failures at a jail.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，这是一个非常合理的疑问。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, that's a very valid question to be asking.
sentences.zh: 这里面可能没有发生什么罪恶的勾当。

sentences.en: And there might not have been something nefarious that happened here.
sentences.zh: 我认为这适用于我们在这里讨论的关于爱泼斯坦及其未解之谜的广泛议题。

sentences.en: And I think that applies to a whole broad range of what we've been talking about here with Epstein and these unanswered questions about him.
sentences.zh: 因为从他2000年代中期在佛罗里达州首次获得这份优待辩诉协议开始，政府就一直在竭尽全力

sentences.en: Because the government, dating back to when he was first had this sweetheart deal down in Florida in the mid-2000s, the government has been fighting tooth and nail
sentences.zh: 对关于爱泼斯坦的秘密信息严加保密。

sentences.en: to keep information about Epstein's secret.
sentences.zh: 显然，爱泼斯坦和他的许多同伙也一直在这样做。

sentences.en: And obviously, Epstein and many of his associates have been doing the same.
sentences.zh: 所以现实情况是，对于很多这样的事情，可能存在无辜的、合乎逻辑的解释。

sentences.en: And so the reality is there might be innocent, logical explanations to a lot of this stuff.
sentences.zh: 我们只是不知道。

sentences.en: We just don't know.
sentences.zh: 而且我仍然不清楚我们何时——如果真的有那一天的话——才能获得我们所需的材料和证据，以便全面、令人满意地回答这些问题。

sentences.en: And it remains unclear to me when, if ever, we are going to get the materials and the evidence we need to be able to fully and satisfactorily answer those questions.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，阴谋论将继续发酵。

sentences.en: And in the meantime, the conspiracy theories will continue to fester.
sentences.zh: 大卫，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: David, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 休息之后，我的同事肖恩·麦克里什将解释为什么这些发酵的阴谋论会在MAGA中占据如此重要的地位。

sentences.en: After the break, my colleague Sean McCreish explains why these festering conspiracy theories have taken such a hold of MAGA.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘。

sentences.en: I'm Wynna Liu.
sentences.zh: 我编写了《纽约时报》游戏中的益智游戏《连线》（Connections）。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖尔斯基。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天都创作“拼字蜜蜂”和“信箱”这两款游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”的特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的，就像你刚才听到的那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games，今天就开始游玩。

sentences.en: Sean, we just spoke with our colleague, David Enrich, about why this Epstein story has been so resonant for so many years.
sentences.zh: 肖恩，我们刚刚和我们的同事大卫·恩里奇谈过，讨论为什么这个爱泼斯坦的故事多年来一直引发如此强烈共鸣。

sentences.en: And now we want to talk about the moment that we're in today, as the suspicions around the Epstein case are crashing around Trump in what seems like a pretty unprecedented way.
sentences.zh: 现在我们要聊聊我们所处的当下，随着围绕爱泼斯坦案的怀疑以一种空前的方式向特朗普砸来。

sentences.en: And we wanted to turn to you to talk about that, because you've spent years getting inside the MAGA movement.
sentences.zh: 我们想找你聊聊这个，因为你花了多年时间深入了解MAGA运动内部。

sentences.en: Help us understand the reaction within the base to this moment.
sentences.zh: 请帮我们理解基层对这一刻的反应。

sentences.en: Yeah, I have to say, this is one of the most fascinating things we have seen in the 10 years that Donald Trump has been on the scene and forging this connection with his base.
sentences.zh: 是的，我必须说，这是唐纳德·特朗普登上政坛并与基层建立这种联系的10年来，我们所见过的最迷人的事情之一。

sentences.en: I think he is having this breakdown with the people who are most loyal to him.
sentences.zh: 我认为他正在与那些对他最忠诚的人发生这种决裂。

sentences.en: And we don't know where it's going to go.
sentences.zh: 而我们不知道事情会走向何方。

sentences.en: There are signs that Trump has started perhaps to turn the page.
sentences.zh: 有迹象表明，特朗普或许已经开始翻篇了。

sentences.en: It's still too soon to say.
sentences.zh: 现在下结论还为时过早。

sentences.en: And yet, no matter what, this has been a fascinating, rich case study in how Trump connects with his base, what some of his political vulnerabilities are,
sentences.zh: 然而无论如何，这都是一个引人入胜、内容丰富的案例研究，展示了特朗普如何与他的基层建立联系、他的一些政治脆弱性是什么，

sentences.en: the playbook he runs to anytime he's in trouble, and the White House's misunderstanding and mishandling of a five-alarm fire with their own base.
sentences.zh: 每当他遇到麻烦时就会使用的剧本，以及白宫对他们自己基层的一场五级大火的误解和糟糕处理。

sentences.en: Okay, let's talk about the mishandling of the five-alarm fire.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们来聊聊对这场五级大火的糟糕处理。

sentences.en: Walk us through how that happened.
sentences.zh: 给我们讲讲这是怎么发生的。

sentences.en: This cycle really began when the Department of Justice put out this two-page memo, essentially closing the Epstein investigation, telling everybody,
sentences.zh: 这个周期真正开始于司法部发布了一份两页的备忘录，基本上关闭了爱泼斯坦的调查，告诉所有人，

sentences.en: yeah, not much to see here, time to move on.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这里没什么好看的，是时候前进了。

sentences.en: And how many of you raise your hand, think this is a big deal, the Epstein thing, would you raise your hand?
sentences.zh: 有多少人举手认为这是一件大事，关于爱泼斯坦的事，你们会举手吗？

sentences.en: So, I mean, every hand has gone up.
sentences.zh: 所以，我的意思是，每只手都举起来了。

sentences.en: And so, you know, people are saying it's a big deal, Steve.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，人们都在说这是一件大事，史蒂夫。

sentences.en: Very soon you started seeing a chorus of angry voices, and they were not the usual suspects here.
sentences.zh: 很快你就会看到一唱一和的愤怒声音，而这里的可不是什么通常的怀疑对象。

sentences.en: You saw people like Charlie Kirk.
sentences.zh: 你看到了像查理·柯克这样的人。

sentences.en: We want answers at some point.
sentences.zh: 我们在某个时候想要答案。

sentences.en: Yeah, answer the questions.
sentences.zh: 对，回答这些问题。

sentences.en: That's it.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: Megyn Kelly.
sentences.zh: 梅根·凯利。

sentences.en: It's about transparency.
sentences.zh: 这是关于透明度。

sentences.en: One of the main reasons that we voted Trump in was because we wanted real answers on real stories, and we didn't want to be BS'd anymore.
sentences.zh: 我们投票让特朗普上台的主要原因之一，是因为我们想要真实报道的真实答案，我们不想再被忽悠了。

sentences.en: The fact that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 事实上，美国

sentences.en: government, the one that I voted for, refused.
sentences.zh: 政府，我投票选出的那个政府，拒绝了。

sentences.en: You saw Tucker Carlson.
sentences.zh: 你看到了塔克·卡尔森。

sentences.en: To take my question seriously, and instead said, case closed, shut up, conspiracy theorist, was too much for me.
sentences.zh: 认真对待我的问题，反而说“结案吧，闭嘴吧，阴谋论者”，这对我来说太过分了。

sentences.en: Suddenly, they were all sort of singing the same song, and it was not the song that the White House was singing.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，他们都在唱同一首歌，而这并不是白宫在唱的歌。

sentences.en: And then Trump starts making it worse.
sentences.zh: 然后特朗普开始让事情变得更糟。

sentences.en: Posting online this morning, he writes, my past supporters have bought into this, he used the word bullshit, hook, line, and sinker.
sentences.zh: 他今天早上在网上发帖写道，我过去的拥护者们完全相信了这一点——他用了“胡扯”这个词——深信不疑。

sentences.en: He goes on to say, let these weaklings continue forward and do the Democrats' work.
sentences.zh: 接着他又说，让这些弱者继续前进，去干民主党人的活吧。

sentences.en: He finally decides to weigh in, and when he does so, he does it in this dismissive, condescending, high-handed way.
sentences.zh: 他终于决定发声，而当他发声时，他是以这种轻蔑、高高在上、居高临下的方式进行的。

sentences.en: It's all been a big hoax.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是个巨大的骗局。

sentences.en: It's perpetrated by the Democrats, and some stupid Republicans and foolish Republicans fall into the net.
sentences.zh: 这是由民主党人策划的，一些愚蠢的共和党人和糊涂的共和党人掉进了网里。

sentences.en: And anybody who cares about this, you know, is wasting their time.
sentences.zh: 任何关心这件事的人，你知道，都在浪费时间。

sentences.en: Total disaster the way Trump handled all this.
sentences.zh: 特朗普处理这一切的方式简直是一场彻底的灾难。

sentences.en: Comments like those just made everything worse.
sentences.zh: 诸如此类的评论让一切变得更糟。

sentences.en: I feel really betrayed, and I feel really, really angry.
sentences.zh: 我感到非常背叛，我感到非常非常愤怒。

sentences.en: The young men and the Gen Z audience that I represent, they are flaming mad right now about this stuff.
sentences.zh: 我所代表的年轻人和Z世代观众，现在对这些事情气急败坏。

sentences.en: We are, in fact, not stupid.
sentences.zh: 我们实际上并不愚蠢。

sentences.en: I really think that nothing should commit us further to wanting to unpack the Epstein story than the amount of gaslighting that is currently taking place.
sentences.zh: 我真的认为，鉴于目前正在发生的这种大规模气灯效应，没有什么比这更能让我们坚定想要解开爱泼斯坦故事的决心了。

sentences.en: These people who normally are just so in lockstep with everything, and they can find ways to twist themselves, always to deflect blame from Trump.
sentences.zh: 这些人平时总是对一切都步调一致，他们总能找到方法扭曲自己，总是为了替特朗普开脱责任。

sentences.en: This was kind of one of the first times where a lot of them looked past any sort of fall guy and said, no, no, no, he's being really weird about this.
sentences.zh: 这可以说是他们中的很多人第一次越过了任何替罪羊，然后说，不，不，不，他在这件事上的表现真的很诡异。

sentences.en: Why is he doing this?
sentences.zh: 他为什么要这么做？

sentences.en: His answers are shocking me.
sentences.zh: 他的回答让我震惊。

sentences.en: And that felt different.
sentences.zh: 这感觉不一样了。

sentences.en: What do you think that's about, Sean?
sentences.zh: 肖恩，你觉得这到底是怎么回事？

sentences.en: Like, why is this the thing that's making them, for the first time maybe ever, start to really question this guy that has seemed so invulnerable with this core group for so long?
sentences.zh: 比如，为什么偏偏是这件事，让他们可能破天荒第一次开始真正质疑这个长期以来在核心群体中似乎刀枪不入的家伙？

sentences.en: Trump's inexplicable behavior around this subject shatters an entire worldview that if you are a hardcore MAGA person and you've been marinating in these concepts
sentences.zh: 特朗普围绕这个话题莫名其妙的行为，彻底粉碎了一种世界观：如果你是一个铁杆的MAGA支持者，并且已经在这些概念

sentences.en: and these storylines for a decade now, the way he's behaving around this conspiracy and this case and this subject, it just does not comport with the shared reality
sentences.zh: 和这些故事情节中浸泡了十年之久，那么他在这个阴谋、这个案件以及这个话题周围的行为，根本与你和其他特朗普支持者共同生活的现实

sentences.en: that you've lived in with other Trump supporters.
sentences.zh: 格格不入。

sentences.en: And I think to understand that, you have to go way back to the beginning of Donald Trump as a political phenomenon.
sentences.zh: 我想理解这一点，你必须追溯到唐纳德·特朗普作为一种政治现象的最开始。

sentences.en: He springs to power at this time of just total distrust, cynicism, and even nihilism in the country following two failed wars, one of which was premised on false intelligence,
sentences.zh: 他在国家充满极度不信任、玩世不恭甚至虚无主义的时刻崛起，此前经历了两次失败的战争——其中一场以虚假情报为前提——

sentences.en: a financial crisis in which all the rich people who perpetrated it paid no price and normal people got screwed over.
sentences.zh: 以及一场金融危机，在这场危机中，所有犯下罪行的富人都没有付出代价，而普通人却被坑惨了。

sentences.en: And Trump comes along and he says, everything you think is happening behind the curtain is happening.
sentences.zh: 然后特朗普出现了，他说，你们认为在幕后发生的一切，其实都在发生。

sentences.en: Trust me, I know, I've seen it.
sentences.zh: 相信我，我知道，我见识过。

sentences.en: I know how politicians are.
sentences.zh: 我知道政客们是什么样的。

sentences.en: The people that have sold this country down the river, they play by a different set of rules.
sentences.zh: 那些把这个国家出卖的人，他们按另一套规则行事。

sentences.en: They never get in trouble.
sentences.zh: 他们从来不会陷入麻烦。

sentences.en: I am a truth teller.
sentences.zh: 我是说真话的人。

sentences.en: I'm going to rip the face off of this thing and you can trust me, so come along for the ride.
sentences.zh: 我要撕下这玩意的面具，你可以相信我，所以跟着我一起上路吧。

sentences.en: And every bad thing that happens to Trump following that point only reinforces the narrative.
sentences.zh: 此后发生在特朗普身上的每一件坏事，都只会强化这种叙事。

sentences.en: So every investigation against him, every scandal,
sentences.zh: 所以针对他的每一次调查、每一个丑闻、

sentences.en: every attempt by the Washington insider class to throttle him, it all fits into the worldview that the establishment is out to get him because he's telling these difficult truths
sentences.zh: 华盛顿内部阶层压制他的每一次尝试，这一切都符合这样一种世界观：建制派之所以要搞他，是因为他在讲这些关于真实情况的、

sentences.en: about what's really happening.
sentences.zh: 难以接受的真相。

sentences.en: This is the mind frame inside the MAGA movement.
sentences.zh: 这就是MAGA运动内部的心态。

sentences.en: And the Epstein case, which is murky and shadowy and sort of all-encompassing, and still there are major unanswered questions there, legitimate questions,
sentences.zh: 而爱泼斯坦案——它晦暗不明、扑朔迷离且无所不包，而且其中仍然存在重大的未解之谜、合理的问题——

sentences.en: but it just fits into these themes so well because it's about, you know, at its core, rich people getting away with horrible things.
sentences.zh: 但它完美地契合了这些主题，因为它的核心，你知道的，就是富人逃脱了可怕罪行的惩罚。

sentences.en: And that just slots so well into the worldview that he's seated.
sentences.zh: 这非常契合他所种下的世界观。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's like you're saying this is actually the exact thing that Trump promised to reveal to the public, to fight against, like in an us versus them.
sentences.zh: 这就好比你说的，这其实正是特朗普承诺要向公众揭露、要去对抗的东西，就像是我们对阵他们一样。

sentences.en: The us was the people and the them was elites like Epstein, right?
sentences.zh: “我们”是人民，“他们”是像爱泼斯坦这样的精英，对吧？

sentences.en: And the people he surrounded himself with.
sentences.zh: 还有那些被他众星拱月般围在身边的人。

sentences.en: And in this case, it sounds like Trump is making it seem like he's siding with the elites.
sentences.zh: 而在这种情况下，听起来特朗普的表现好像是在和精英们站在一边。

sentences.en: Yeah, it does seem like that.
sentences.zh: 是的，看起来确实如此。

sentences.en: And so there's a little bit of suspicion creeping in now where for the first time, if you are not poised to defend his every word and deed
sentences.zh: 所以现在开始滋生了一点怀疑，破天荒第一次，如果你没有准备好去为他的每一言每一行辩护，

sentences.en: and you actually stop and look at some of it, as some of his supporters are now doing for the first time ever, things start to fall apart.
sentences.zh: 而是真正停下来看看其中的一些事情——正如他的一些支持者现在破天荒第一次正在做的那样——事情开始分崩离析了。

sentences.en: And it's a worldview that falls apart.
sentences.zh: 而且崩塌的是一种世界观。

sentences.en: Is this just MAGA influencers?
sentences.zh: 这只是MAGA网红们的行为吗？

sentences.en: Or do you sense that the frustration runs deeper and more broadly than that?
sentences.zh: 还是你觉得这种沮丧情绪比这更深、更广？

sentences.en: That's a great question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个好问题。

sentences.en: It's something we think about all the time as Washington reporters, right?
sentences.zh: 这是我们作为华盛顿记者一直在思考的事情，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, do these storylines that we're fixating on actually resonate?
sentences.zh: 比如，我们紧盯的这些故事情节真的能引起共鸣吗？

sentences.en: And I would say this one absolutely does.
sentences.zh: 我想说，这个绝对可以。

sentences.en: This is a real thing out there in the country.
sentences.zh: 这是全国上下真实存在的情况。

sentences.en: You know, I'm from a lower middle-class town in Pennsylvania, and I've got Trump voting friends who, one of them reached out to me the other day and was like,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我来自宾夕法尼亚州的一个下中产阶级小镇，我有投特朗普的朋友，其中一个人前几天联系我，说，

sentences.en: we are so disgusted with this Epstein thing.
sentences.zh: 我们对这个爱泼斯坦的事情感到太恶心了。

sentences.en: We don't understand why he's being like this.
sentences.zh: 我们不明白他为什么会这样。

sentences.en: And I've got sources who are Mar-a-Lago members that are diehard Donald Trump supporters, rich people who I'm asking, what do you think of all this?
sentences.zh: 我有一些消息源是海湖庄园的会员，他们是死心塌地的唐纳德·特朗普支持者，都是有钱人，我问他们，你们怎么看这一切？

sentences.en: And they're sort of just saying, yeah, it's really unfortunate.
sentences.zh: 而他们的回答基本上是，好吧，这真的很不幸。

sentences.en: It's strange.
sentences.zh: 这很奇怪。

sentences.en: Like, we need more answers.
sentences.zh: 比如，我们需要更多的答案。

sentences.en: And so it's everybody from the Mar-a-Lago club members to, you know, my welder buddies in Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 所以从海湖俱乐部会员，到你知道的，我在宾夕法尼亚州的焊工哥们，每个人都在谈论。

sentences.en: It's kind of fascinating to me that you're saying a lot of this is like an own goal by Trump.
sentences.zh: 我觉得很有意思的是，你说这其中很大一部分就像是特朗普自己踢进的乌龙球。

sentences.en: You know, this comes from his own mistakes in addressing his base.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这是因为他在应对自己的基层时犯了错误。

sentences.en: That's something he's normally so good at, reading his base, telling them exactly what they want to hear.
sentences.zh: 这通常是他非常擅长的领域，了解他的基层，告诉他们他们最想听的话。

sentences.en: Why do you think he misread the situation this time?
sentences.zh: 你认为他为什么这次会误判形势？

sentences.en: Yes, yes, yes, yes.
sentences.zh: 对，对，对，对。

sentences.en: That's what makes this so fascinating.
sentences.zh: 这就是让这件事如此引人入胜的原因。

sentences.en: He's so in touch with that base.
sentences.zh: 他与那个基层的联系是如此紧密。

sentences.en: I traveled around the country.
sentences.zh: 我走遍了全国各地。

sentences.en: I've been to a million Trump rallies.
sentences.zh: 我去过数百万场特朗普的集会。

sentences.en: He listens to the roar of the crowd and goes where it tells him to go.
sentences.zh: 他倾听人群的呐喊，并顺应他们的呼声。

sentences.en: He knows what they want.
sentences.zh: 他知道他们想要什么。

sentences.en: And so it's this interesting moment where Trump is at the zenith of his political power.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个有趣的时刻，特朗普正处于其政治权力的巅峰。

sentences.en: But I think there are many people in the movement who are starting to wonder, can he still hear them?
sentences.zh: 但我认为运动中的许多人开始怀疑，他还能听到他们的声音吗？

sentences.en: Is he still attuned to the roar that put him in there in the first place?
sentences.zh: 他还能听出最初把他送上台的呐喊声吗？

sentences.en: If he can't hear them and he doesn't know what they want, it brings us to this really interesting moment where, and this is sort of the oldest tale to tell about Washington,
sentences.zh: 如果他听不到他们的声音，也不知道他们想要什么，这就把我们带到了一个非常有趣的时刻，这也是关于华盛顿最古老的说法，

sentences.en: which is that if you don't watch out, you end up becoming the thing you started off scorning.
sentences.zh: 那就是如果你不小心，你最终会变成你一开始鄙视的东西。

sentences.en: And what does it mean to a Trump voter if Trump is now the deep state?
sentences.zh: 如果特朗普现在成了深层政府，这对特朗普的支持者意味着什么？

sentences.en: And that is the question that this entire thing has raised.
sentences.zh: 这就是整件事所引发的问题。

sentences.en: You said at the start of our conversation that it seems like Trump may be finally turning the page on some of this.
sentences.zh: 你在我们对话开始时说过，特朗普似乎终于开始对其中一些事情翻篇了。

sentences.en: What makes you think that?
sentences.zh: 是什么让你这么认为？

sentences.en: Well, it's unclear yet where that will go, but something interesting happened a couple days ago, which is that the Wall Street Journal published this big story
sentences.zh: 嗯，目前还不清楚事情会走向何方，但几天前发生了一件有趣的事，那就是《华尔街日报》发表了一篇长篇报道，

sentences.en: that described a birthday scrapbook that had been given to Jeffrey Epstein in 2003.
sentences.zh: 其中描述了一本在2003年赠送给杰弗里·爱泼斯坦的生日纪念册。

sentences.en: And the journal alleged that Trump had written a note in the scrapbook and he'd done a drawing of a naked woman in there.
sentences.zh: 《华尔街日报》声称特朗普在这本纪念册里写过便条，还在里面画了一个裸体女人。

sentences.en: And Trump's note to Epstein, according to the journal, ended by saying, happy birthday and may every day be another wonderful secret.
sentences.zh: 根据《华尔街日报》的报道，特朗普给爱泼斯坦的便条结尾是：祝生日快乐，愿每一天都是另一个美妙的秘密。

sentences.en: Last night after that story was published,
sentences.zh: 就在昨天那篇报道发表之后，

sentences.en: Trump slammed the piece in a Truth Social post, calling it false.
sentences.zh: 特朗普在“真实社交”上的一篇帖子里猛烈抨击了这篇文章，称其为虚假消息。

sentences.en: Trump denied the story and the White House tried to kill it.
sentences.zh: 特朗普否认了这个故事，白宫则试图将之扼杀。

sentences.en: He wrote in Truth Social that he filed a powerhouse lawsuit against anyone involved in publishing the false, malicious, defamatory, fake news article
sentences.zh: 他在“真实社交”上写道，他已对任何参与在《华尔街日报》这份毫无价值的废纸上

sentences.en: in the useless rag that is the Wall Street Journal.
sentences.zh: 发表这篇虚假、恶意、诽谤性、假新闻文章的人提起了一场强有力的诉讼。

sentences.en: Nonetheless, when the story came out, I think for a large portion of Trump's base, this sort of muscle memory kicked in, which is that the base runs to defend him.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，当这篇报道问世时，我认为对于特朗普的大部分基层来说，这种肌肉记忆被激活了，那就是基层会奔向支持他。

sentences.en: As soon as I read the story, I said, this is the dumbest, obviously fakest thing.
sentences.zh: 我一读到这篇报道就说，这是最愚蠢、显然最假的事情。

sentences.en: I don't believe it.
sentences.zh: 我不相信。

sentences.en: This is a nothing burger.
sentences.zh: 这完全是无稽之谈。

sentences.en: It's an absolute nothing burger.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是空穴来风。

sentences.en: I laughed when I saw it.
sentences.zh: 我看到的时候笑了。

sentences.en: The Murdochs concocted something last night and thought it'd be a kill shot on President Trump.
sentences.zh: 默多克家族昨晚炮制了些东西，以为这会是对特朗普总统的致命一击。

sentences.en: And lo and behold, it's the exact opposite.
sentences.zh: 结果却恰恰相反。

sentences.en: Nothing unites MAGA like fake news.
sentences.zh: 没有什么比假新闻更能凝聚MAGA了。

sentences.en: And so here, Trump finally starts to find his wartime footing.
sentences.zh: 所以在这里，特朗普终于找到了他的战时状态。

sentences.en: Finally, he had kind of a weapon and he knew how to use it.
sentences.zh: 终于，他有了一种武器，并且他知道如何使用它。

sentences.en: And the weapon was what he claimed was this fake story.
sentences.zh: 而这个武器就是他所声称的这个假故事。

sentences.en: And look at me and look, they're coming after me and it's a hoax and you can't trust them and I'm going to sue Rupert Murdoch.
sentences.zh: 看看我，看呐，他们冲我来了，这是个骗局，你不能相信他们，我要起诉鲁珀特·默多克。

sentences.en: And so now he's on the attack and he's always good when he's on the attack, right?
sentences.zh: 所以现在他开始进攻了，当他发起进攻时他总是很擅长，对吧？

sentences.en: Will this work though?
sentences.zh: 但这真的有用吗？

sentences.en: I mean, these are people who have really seemed to have a very real and frankly understandable desire for more clarity and transparency around the Epstein investigation.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这些人似乎对围绕爱泼斯坦调查获得更多清晰度和透明度有着非常真实且坦白说可以理解的渴望。

sentences.en: Do you think they're just going to suddenly abandon that in favor of lining up behind Trump?
sentences.zh: 你觉得他们会为了排队支持特朗普而突然放弃这一点吗？

sentences.en: It seems hard to believe.
sentences.zh: 这似乎很难让人相信。

sentences.en: I think one of the things that they were disgusted about was Trump's tone when talking about this sort of just this boring story and, you know, only idiots would care about this.
sentences.zh: 我想他们感到厌恶的一点是，特朗普在谈到这种无聊的事情时那种语气，你知道的，只有白痴才会关心这种事。

sentences.en: This is what was really incensing them as well.
sentences.zh: 这也是真正激怒他们的地方。

sentences.en: And that goes to the reality that they care really deeply about this because it's a really awful story that should be cared about.
sentences.zh: 这就说明了一个现实，那就是他们对此非常在意，因为这是一个确实很糟糕、应该受到关注的故事。

sentences.en: And so I just don't see how you can drop that.
sentences.zh: 所以我实在不明白你怎么能把这事放下。

sentences.en: I mean, it's, you know, we keep using words like conspiracies and we are talking about some conspiracy theories here, but they are connected to very real crimes.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们一直使用阴谋之类的词，我们在这里也确实在谈论一些阴谋论，但它们与非常真实的犯罪有关。

sentences.en: And there's a reason why this case gripped the public imagination.
sentences.zh: 这个案子之所以能抓住公众的想象力，是有原因的。

sentences.en: It was much bigger than politics.
sentences.zh: 这远比政治要宏大。

sentences.en: I mean, everybody knows about this and follows this.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，每个人都知道这件事并一直在关注。

sentences.en: And yet I feel that the theme of Trump's political moment is that he kind of always comes back.
sentences.zh: 然而我觉得，特朗普政治生涯的主题就是他似乎总是能卷土重来。

sentences.en: I mean, it's also hard to see this being the thing that leads to like a break long term.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，也很难看出这件事会成为导致长期决裂的导火索。

sentences.en: It's true.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: He always finds a way to keep his people on side.
sentences.zh: 他总能找到办法让支持者站在他这边。

sentences.en: He's also a master at creating his own reality to suit his needs.
sentences.zh: 他也是创造符合自己需求的现实的大师。

sentences.en: And it's always been true of Trump that he's most wily when he's in a foxhole.
sentences.zh: 特朗普一直都是这样，当他身处绝境时，往往是最精明狡猾的。

sentences.en: And he's certainly in one now.
sentences.zh: 而他现在显然就处在绝境之中。

sentences.en: And yet it's also true that this is not quite over.
sentences.zh: 然而同样不可否认的是，这件事还没完全结束。

sentences.en: There are some big looming questions that we don't know the answers to yet.
sentences.zh: 还有一些悬而未决的重大问题，我们目前还不知道答案。

sentences.en: Will the Trump administration ever really be able to give
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府是否真的能够提供

sentences.en: enough information to satisfy its base about the Epstein saga?
sentences.zh: 足够的信息，来平息其核心选民对爱泼斯坦丑闻的疑虑？

sentences.en: Is it ever going to be enough?
sentences.zh: 这永远足够吗？

sentences.en: And what's going to happen now with this lawsuit that he's waging against Rupert Murdoch?
sentences.zh: 他目前对鲁珀特·默多克发起的这场诉讼接下来会怎样？

sentences.en: And will the White House be able to turn the page and get the message onto the next story they want it to be?
sentences.zh: 白宫能否翻开新的一页，将舆论焦点转移到他们希望关注的下一个故事上？

sentences.en: It could take some time before we learn how it's all going to play out.
sentences.zh: 这可能需要一些时间，我们才能知道这一切最终会如何收场。

sentences.en: Sean, thanks so much.
sentences.zh: 肖恩，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: A former Jeffrey Epstein employee told Times reporters that she spoke with the FBI in 1996
sentences.zh: 一名杰弗里·爱泼斯坦的前雇员告诉《泰晤士报》记者，她曾在1996年

sentences.en: and again in 2006 about a troubling encounter with Trump in Epstein's office where she said
sentences.zh: 以及2006年再次与联邦调查局谈及她在爱泼斯坦办公室与特朗普的一次令人不安的遭遇，当时她表示

sentences.en: Trump hovered over her and stared at her bare legs making her feel scared.
sentences.zh: 特朗普居高临下地站在她身旁，盯着她光着的双腿，让她感到害怕。

sentences.en: She was in her mid-20s at the time.
sentences.zh: 她当时二十多岁。

sentences.en: The White House contested the account saying Trump was never in Epstein's office.
sentences.zh: 白宫对这一说法提出了异议，称特朗普从未去过爱泼斯坦的办公室。

sentences.en: The story shows how the investigative files on Epstein could contain embarrassing material for Trump even if it's largely unrelated to Epstein's crimes and was never fully
sentences.zh: 这个故事表明，关于爱泼斯坦的调查档案可能会包含让特朗普感到尴尬的材料，尽管这与爱泼斯坦的罪行基本无关，且从未被完全

sentences.en: investigated or corroborated.
sentences.zh: 调查或证实。

sentences.en: And Israeli forces killed more than
sentences.zh: 据加沙卫生部和卫生工作者称

sentences.en: 60 Palestinians on Sunday in northern Gaza after crowds gathered near a crossing from Israel to try to seize aid from United Nations trucks according to the
sentences.zh: 周日，以色列军队在加沙北部打死了60多名巴勒斯坦人，当时人群聚集在从以色列进入加沙的一个过境点附近，试图抢夺联合国卡车上的救援物资。

sentences.en: Gaza Health Ministry and health workers.
sentences.zh: 加沙卫生部和卫生工作者如是说。

sentences.en: The Israeli military disputed the number of fatalities but didn't offer an alternative number and said soldiers had opened fire to remove an immediate threat but didn't specify
sentences.zh: 以色列军方对死亡人数提出了异议，但没有提供其他数字，并表示士兵开枪是为了消除迫在眉睫的威胁，但没有具体说明

sentences.en: what that threat was.
sentences.zh: 那是什么威胁。

sentences.en: It was the latest violence connected to a new food distribution system that was introduced by Israel nearly two months ago.
sentences.zh: 这是与以色列近两个月前推出的一项新粮食分配系统相关的最新暴力事件。

sentences.en: The UN said last week that more than
sentences.zh: 联合国上周表示，已有超过

sentences.en: 670 Palestinians had been killed in attacks near sites built under the new system.
sentences.zh: 670名巴勒斯坦人在新系统下建设的地点附近的袭击中丧生。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Rob Zipko and Caitlin O'Keefe with help from Mary Wilson.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由罗布·济普科和凯特琳·奥基夫制作，玛丽·威尔逊提供了帮助。

sentences.en: It was edited by Devin Taylor.
sentences.zh: 节目由德文·泰勒剪辑。

sentences.en: Contains original music by Dan Powell,
sentences.zh: 包含丹·鲍威尔的原创音乐，

sentences.en: Rowan Nemisto,
sentences.zh: 罗温·内米斯托，

sentences.en: Diane Wong, and Marion Lozano and was engineered by Alyssa Moxley.
sentences.zh: 黛安·黄和马里恩·洛扎诺，并由阿丽莎·莫克斯利进行混音工程。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landsberg of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题曲由旺德利的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰兹伯格创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是今天的《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: I'm Natalie Kittroweff.
sentences.zh: 我是娜塔莉·基特罗夫。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》我们将为假期接待客人做好准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让您的客人在家中感到宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种一关灯就能睡着的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they black out to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会因断片而睡着。

sentences.en: I mean what kind of light do they require because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是他们需要什么样的光线环境，因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在纽约时报应用程序或您喜欢收听播客的任何地方查找《Wirecutter秀》。
